intent: A creator discloses a Skill under a name of their own, at an address anyone can open, without the platform's catalog vouching for it.
observable_outcome: An account registers one permanent publisher name, publishes a Skill as an immutable release pinned to one version, and the public address follows the version's current governance on every read.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An account registers at most one publisher name, the name follows the Skill name rule, refuses reserved words in any hyphenated spelling, and is unique across the site.
Publishing refuses a licence hold, a blocked or unknown redistribution verdict, and content the author supplied or the platform generated unless the author states they may distribute it.
Each publish adds a release pinning a version and its content hash; a release can never be changed or removed except by purging the account.
The public address shows content only while the publication is listed and the pinned Skill is neither taken down, held, nor judged not redistributable.
